columns.name: window_label

columns.name: median_predicted_deviation_s
columns.description: Exact median predicted minus scheduled arrival in seconds over the window's eligible predictions.

columns.name: p90_predicted_deviation_s
columns.description: Exact 90th percentile of predicted deviation in seconds.

columns.name: median_abs_revision_s
columns.description: Exact median absolute revision in seconds over eligible predictions with a prior snapshot.

columns.name: n_eligible
columns.description: Eligible predictions in the window.

columns.name: implausible_deviation_count

columns.name: coverage_denominator

columns.name: skipped_stop_count
columns.description: Covered trip stops in the window whose latest usable snapshot is SKIPPED.

columns.name: skipped_share
columns.description: skipped_stop_count / coverage_denominator, a fraction between 0 and 1.

tables.name: agg_quality_checks_hourly
tables.description: Hourly data-quality checks (prediction_coverage and schedule_join_coverage consider observable trip stops only) with warn/fail status from the quality_thresholds seed. Values are percentages except missed_runs and duplicate_deliveries (counts per hour; duplicate_deliveries is the number of extra scheduler deliveries). implausible_deviation_share is the percentage of last-snapshot picks more than 3600 s from the schedule. late_event_share counts records fetched more than 300 seconds after their event_ts. vehicle_count_drop compares with the same hour one week earlier and is no_baseline when that hour was not observed.
tables.freshness: Refreshed with each gold export (about every 15 minutes). The API caches responses for 300 s; the site marks data stale once the export is older than 60 minutes.
tables.coverage: No coverage column. Values are served as stored.

columns.description: Service date.

columns.description: Local clock hour (0-23).

columns.description: Measured value; null when it cannot be computed.

columns.description: ok, warn, fail, no_baseline, no_data or no_service (the hour has fewer scheduled subway trip-stops than no_service_min_trip_stops; content checks only).
